notes: Born November 6, 1940, Moravská Ostrava (Ostrava), Czech Republic. Family fled East Germany to West Germany. Father Karl Albert Uchtdorf (customs officer, conscripted into German Army). Mother Hildegard Else Opelt. Married Harriet Reich December 14, 1962, Bern Switzerland Temple. 2 children, 6 grandchildren. German/Czech background - very low probability of LDS pioneer kinship. Dead end expected.
